name: Unified Inbox (UAI)
problem: Enterprise clients needed a single, AI-augmented inbox to unify fragmented customer conversations across channels — but requirements were scattered across stakeholders with no shared source of truth.
research: Ran stakeholder interviews across client and engineering teams; mapped existing workflows and UI pain points to identify where AI could realistically remove manual triage effort.
solution: Structured business and functional requirements into user stories, workflows and feature specs that engineering could build against directly, including AI-assisted triage use cases.
execution: Coordinated with AI and engineering teams on functional documentation, sprint scoping and UI enhancement rollout.
contribution: End-to-end requirement gathering, workflow definition, user story authorship, and stakeholder alignment as lead BA.
impact: Reduced requirement ambiguity across enterprise rollout, tightening scope control and accelerating feature delivery.

name: ESCRA
problem: Blockchain-based workflows needed precise functional and technical framing to bridge client intent and development execution.
research: Worked directly with client and dev teams to unpack blockchain-specific workflow requirements not covered by standard BA frameworks.
solution: Framed functional and technical requirements for blockchain workflows, translating domain-specific logic into implementable specs.
execution: Served as primary liaison between clients and developers; supported sprint planning and scope alignment in an Agile environment.
contribution: Requirements analysis, documentation ownership, and cross-team liaison.
impact: Kept blockchain workflow scope aligned across client and engineering, avoiding rework from misinterpreted requirements.

name: SAGINT — Tokenized Compliance System
problem: Rare earth mineral supply chains needed a compliance system aligned to US government DFARS requirements — a highly confidential, high-stakes traceability problem.
research: Analyzed DFARS compliance requirements and existing supply-chain verification gaps.
solution: Contributed to compliance-focused documentation and blockchain-based tokenization mechanisms for supply chain verification.
execution: Maintained requirement traceability across a confidential, government-aligned workstream.
contribution: Compliance documentation and requirement traceability support on Sagint OS.
impact: Supporting a nationally significant supply-chain verification initiative with audit-ready traceability.

name: LifeSaver — Blood Donation Inventory Management
problem: Blood banks and donors lacked a streamlined system for donor enrollment, appointment scheduling and inventory tracking.
research: Studied donor engagement drop-off points and inventory tracking inefficiencies in existing blood bank systems.
solution: Built a full MERN-stack blood inventory management system covering donor enrollment, scheduling and inventory tracking.
execution: Solo-architected and developed the platform end-to-end; authored and published a research paper on the system.
contribution: Full-stack development (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) plus authored research publication.
impact: Improved donor engagement and inventory visibility; published in IRJMETS, Volume 06, Issue 01, 2023.

publication.title: LifeSaver: Blood Donation Management System Web App using MERN Stack
publication.venue: International Research Journal of Modernization in Engineering Technology & Science (IRJMETS)

name: CodeHub
problem: Beginners learning programming fundamentals needed a lightweight, dynamic platform to practice without friction.
research: Benchmarked existing e-learning UX to identify what made lesson delivery feel sluggish or disconnected from practice.
solution: Built a dynamic e-learning platform for programming fundamentals with MySQL-backed data management.
execution: Integrated PHP for dynamic back-end functionality to ensure a seamless learning experience.
contribution: Solo design and development of platform architecture and data layer.
impact: Delivered a seamless, responsive learning experience for programming fundamentals.
